caption: The drawing depicts a colorful statue of a standing male figure positioned atop a rectangular wooden pedestal. The figure is dressed in a red tunic with yellow trim, brown leggings, and brown footwear, with a blue-gray mantle draped over his shoulders and falling behind his back. He has brown hair, some of which extends past his shoulders, and wears a yellow headband. The man is holding a round object, likely a loaf of bread, in his left hand close to his chest, while his right hand grasps a vertical, yellow and black striped pole that stands next to him. The rectangular pedestal supporting the figure appears to be constructed from dark wood, featuring visible grain and joints. The background is plain and off-white, with soft shadows cast by the statue and pedestal.
title: Cigar Store Indian
